topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Finding my college application essay published as an example was a surprise, wrapped in layers of quiet affirmation. It's as if my words, once just a whisper of my ambitions and reflections, have now found a stage to speak louder. I couldn't help but think about the hours spent refining each sentence, the deliberate choice of words to convey not just who I am, but who I aspire to be. Seeing it out there, helping others navigate their own journey, feels like a continuation of the conversation I started. It encourages me to keep writing, to keep sharing, because somewhere out there, my words might just light up a path for someone else.
